{{Quote|I've worked most of my life to bring peace to Garos. Civil war was tearing this world apart, literally.''"<br />"''And you achieved it. Through Imperial might.|[[Tork Winger]] anf [[Alexandra Winger]]|<ref name="BbK">{{JournalCite|12|Betrayal by Knight}}</ref>}}
The '''Garosian civil war''', also known as the '''Garosian conflict''' or the '''Conflict on Garos IV''', was a conflict between the native [[Garosian]]s and the [[Sundar]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garos IV]]. The civil war ended in [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an official presence on Garos IV and executed hundreds of known troublemakers on both sides.<ref name="AGoH" />
